item.title: Popular Youtuber completes 'Kitchen Sink Challenge' at local Logan diner
item.description: Popular Youtuber "BeardMeatsFood" recently finished a massive dessert platter at a local Logan restaurant as part of his ongoing series of food challenges throughout the world.

item.description: The service member was injured earlier this month, according to authorities.

item.title: Iran names Mojtaba Khamenei to succeed his slain father as supreme leader
item.description: Mojtaba Khamenei, the son of Iran's late supreme leader, has been named his successor, Iranian state TV announced early Monday, as the war that began with his father's killing less than two weeks ago took a dramatic turn.

item.title: Crash hospitalizes two in West Valley City
item.description: A crash in West Valley City sent two to the hospital in West Valley City on Sunday evening.

item.title: Missing Garfield County woman's car found in remote area of Carbon County
item.description: The vehicle belonging to a missing woman out of Garfield County was located in a remote area of Carbon County on Thursday.

item.title: 19-year-old dies after ski accident at Alta
item.description: A young man died after colliding with a tree at Alta Ski Area on Sunday.

item.title: 'When I think of fry sauce, I think of something magical': Locals talk Utah's favorite condiment on Fry Sauce Day
item.description: March 8th, declared "Fry Sauce Day" in Utah by Governor Spencer Cox in 2024, brought Utahns out of the woodwork to talk all things fry sauce.

item.title: 2 dead, 1 injured after rollover crash in Southern Idaho
item.description: A man and child are dead, and another child is injured after a single-vehicle crash in Southern Idaho.

item.title: Model trains return to Union Station in annual Model Railroad Festival
item.description: Union Station hosted the 36th annual Hostler Model Railroad Festival, featuring operating train models, contests and vendors.

item.title: Eccles Organ Festival continues with recital at The Cathedral of the Madeleine
item.description: A grand organ sits at the head of a Salt Lake City cathedral, drawing churchgoers and tourists alike to its pews. Its 4,066 pipes and protruding Fanfare Trumpet serenade the cathedral's Spanish Gothic interior each week during mass and even offer a choral sound for the occasional concert.
